about_the_game:
You wake up in a classroom way after your lecture concludes. The person who wakes you up looks familiar. Oh right, it's that one popular guy that everyone likes. Vahn. Wait, Vahn??! Why???

He was in one of your classes this semester, but you've never spoken to him before. Besides you two, the room is empty. Everyone else had already left ages ago. And no one else bothered waking you up? Rude.

With the light of the setting sun on your skin, you engage in conversation with the popular young man, realizing that things are taking a very scandalous turn, and that his interests are far more fascinating than you'd originally think.

Lecture Me Later is an otome/visual novel with a single love interest set in a University  setting. Chat with Vahn and see what kind of freaky interesting things he's into.

Name the (female) MC. Depending on your choices, Vahn may 'say' her name.

A unique 2.5D visual novel experience. A relaxing (as relaxing as classrooms can be...) 3D environment with a nice 2D character to chat with.

An animated and expressive love interest thanks to Live2D Cubism. Vahn has some very... interesting expressions, with more to come in the full release. 

Favorable answer indicator. See what answers and topics Vahn prefers.

A variety of choices for the player, giving fun replay-ability options.

content_descriptors.notes: The demo contains mild language and suggestive themes, including mild, non-explicit text-based BDSM and femdom themes.
